content.title: Reaction Selector Variant | Fixed Menu, Subject Swaps and Send Feedback
content.summary: An adult reaction-card app cycles through three original emotional archetypes and sends the final card. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One fixed interface, one ordered option rail, one current highlight, one result canvas and one send control establish the baseline. + Every visible click changes exactly one selection state before the corresponding subject and graphic language update. + The application frame and control positions remain registered while result subjects, palettes and actions change. + Each result has one distinct readable reaction action rather than a passive portrait or unrelated montage. + The terminal send acknowledgement preserves the last selected result and proves one complete input-to-output loop.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original reaction-card app with a fixed navy header, a left rail of five neutral options, one lime selection highlight, a central card and one bottom-right button labelled "SEND CARD". Click "BOLD WIN" once; preserve the entire interface while an original adult athlete crosses into the card, raises one fist and resolves into an orange illustrated victory portrait. Move the pointer to "SEND CARD", click once and hold a small green sent check beside the unchanged final card; no extra selection or character appears.
required_anchors: One fixed interface, one ordered option rail, one current highlight, one result canvas and one send control establish the baseline.
Every visible click changes exactly one selection state before the corresponding subject and graphic language update.
Each result has one distinct readable reaction action rather than a passive portrait or unrelated montage.
The terminal send acknowledgement preserves the last selected result and proves one complete input-to-output loop.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult reaction-card app cycles through three original emotional archetypes and sends the final card. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 固定应用框架、左侧选项栏、当前高亮和发送按钮持续不变；可见光标每次只选择一个反应类型，主画布随即换成对应人物、配色、短文案和定义动作，最后一次发送反馈证明所有变化来自同一选择系统。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One fixed interface, one ordered option rail, one current highlight, one result canvas and one send control establish the baseline.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One fixed interface, one ordered option rail, one current highlight, one result canvas and one send control establish the baseline."

invariants.rule: Every visible click changes exactly one selection state before the corresponding subject and graphic language update.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every visible click changes exactly one selection state before the corresponding subject and graphic language update."

invariants.rule: The application frame and control positions remain registered while result subjects, palettes and actions change.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The application frame and control positions remain registered while result subjects, palettes and actions change."

invariants.rule: Each result has one distinct readable reaction action rather than a passive portrait or unrelated montage.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Each result has one distinct readable reaction action rather than a passive portrait or unrelated montage."

invariants.rule: The terminal send acknowledgement preserves the last selected result and proves one complete input-to-output loop.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal send acknowledgement preserves the last selected result and proves one complete input-to-output loop."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
